item.title: Rangers beaten on penalties by Celtic
item.description: Celtic have knocked Rangers out of the Scottish Cup with a 4-2 win on penalties at Ibrox. The quarter-final between the two Glasgow rivals finished goalless after extra-time. Celtic and Rangers fans clashed on the pitch afterwards. Advertisement Police and stewards had to form a barrier in the middle of the playing surface to keep them apart. Celtic supporters jumped out of the stands after their victory, and they were then confronted by their Glasgow rivals.

item.title: Tralee branch of Irish Red Cross to hold "Taster Session" for volunteers
item.description: The Tralee branch of the Irish Red Cross is hosting a Free Red Cross 'Taster Session' on Saturday, March 21st to attract prospective members. The branch has recently launched a campaign to recruit adult volunteers to the organisation. The organisation are hoping to strengthen the services they have on offer, which includes first aid, youth services and therapeutic hand care. item.title: State ordered to award Kerry TD 50% of legal costs following Super Junior Ministers challenge
item.description: The State has been ordered to award a Kerry TD 50% of legal costs following an unsuccessful challenge over Super Junior Ministers.
